name: diagram-skills
description: Professional diagram drawing skills: baoyu-diagram generates polished, editable, self-contained SVG for 技术路线图 (roadmaps/timelines), 路径图 (flowcharts/data flows), 框架图 (architecture/structural diagrams), sequence diagrams, mind maps and state machines, with a complete design system (semantic palette, typography scale, spacing/layout math); frontend-design is Anthropic's official aesthetic-calibration skill that keeps visual output looking deliberately designed instead of templated.
